descriptionHtml:
Approach · TC-17 Post-Round Review & Completion · S08 Tracker status × screen: the Meds toggle shows every tracker row with the same status, date and reason as the tracker

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U7 The Meds toggle shows the same Medication Tracker (same data) as the Encounter tab. (UAT TC-17; TFA-92595 AC 5; TFA-92595 How it works 5) — gate: blocked: TFA-92595 in progress
  • U1 The Note / Tasks / Meds toggle shows only one section at a time, and each section shows its own correct content (the three views hold correct, independent data). (UAT TC-17; TFA-92595 AC 2; TFA-92595 How it works 1) — gate: blocked: TFA-92595 in progress

Test design technique: Decision table (decision-table) — List the combinations of several conditions and check each one, to see that the result follows the rule.

Given A Hospital patient in note-ready whose tracker has one row per status, each status with its own date, plus an active row last mentioned 20 h ago; a second Hospital patient and the Nursing Home resident each with one decoy medication

When Look at the Pre-Round Medications panel (the tracker on main), the Encounter tab, and the Post-Round meds toggle

Then For each row the Post-Round meds toggle shows what the tracker shows, in the same row: active → listed with no tag; held → 'Held · Oct 12' + 'AKI'; changed → 'Changed · Oct 10' + 'was 40 mg'; discontinued → 'Stopped · Oct 9'; single-dose → 'Given · Oct 8'; no row missing, none added (no decoy from another patient or context), no note or task text

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): oracle.mjs: cp1 and cp3 mustContain all six names, the four tag+date strings and both reasons; cp3 mustNotContain note text, the resident or either decoy. Each status has its own date, so a tag/date swap between rows is caught page-wide; …

Where it ran: dev; test method PW · Playwright script; lane planned in the matrix: browser agent (blocked)

S08 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-17.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Environment: dev — dev deployment, build e02167f (Deploy Convex, 2026-10-12T18:24:27Z); account and address are not written into the report; run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev.

Test method: PW · Playwright script; secondary: AGENT · Browser agent — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on both; Source: dev.
